candidates.description: This feature vector represents quantitative units of measurement and scale.
This vector represents numerical digits, quantities, or numerical values frequently appearing in data.
This vector represents common French noun and verb suffixes or ending letter combinations containing double 's'.
This vector activates in contexts related to biological structures, cellular components, and physiological processes.
This feature vector activates on French demonstrative and possessive determiners and pronouns, particularly masculine, feminine, and plural forms indicating possession or specificity.
This vector represents the concept of sensory experiences, feelings, and cultural perceptions.
This vector represents third-person and first-person personal pronouns in French and related languages.
This feature vector activates strongly on words and subwords related to geographical names, French vocabulary, and words with high semantic intensity or density.
This vector activates on words, suffixes, and name fragments ending with the letter combination "-ent".
This vector represents concepts related to uncertainty, distinction, and logical possibilities or outcomes.
